items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section VIII, List of Answers on Topics 89:1
items.html: The Nefesh, Ruach, and Neshama of the righteous are phases of BYA, but from the internality of BYA. And it is known that all of BYA are considered phases of VAK of ZON of Atzilut, hence ZON of Atzilut are considered the upper one to the souls of the righteous, and they are born through them, for every upper one emanates the lower degree adjacent to it. (Inner Light, page 669, Sub Header, “Adam”)
